_doc: Wave 6.5 source audit of assets/tiles/topdown (30 painterly 512px plates). FILENAMES ARE UNRELIABLE — 'true_content' below is what the image ACTUALLY shows (verified by eye on labeled contact sheets). 'role' is how the realization pipeline uses it: ground / ground-variant / path / wall / ritual / prop-diorama / unusable-for-now. 'output' is the semantic asset tools/make_tiles.py emits under client/assets/tiles/.
